body:
GitHub https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/1488

## Summary
The supplied `status` claim detail (DCP-V1-187, from #1244) admits only `blocked`, `ready` and `proven`. A producer's proof/readiness ledger commonly also records partial proof, a subject that cannot be demonstrated through the tested interface, an open discrepancy, an obsolete subject, a not-established outcome, a qualified/provisional outcome, and `unknown`. None of these can be supplied, so most status rows are lost before import.

## Environment
- Build: main-ef2a01d.
- Producer ledger: 203 work-package status rows and 1,862 readiness rows (all `unknown`).

## Reproduction
1. Adoption provider with flow `p:flow:a` and a claim on it with detail `{"status": {"state": "partial", "reason": "two of five criteria proven", "supporting": []}}`.
2. Build -> refused `invalid supplied status`.
3. Same with `unknown`, `not-demonstrable`, `disputed`, `obsolete`.

## Measured
Of 203 work-package rows, 79 map to `blocked`/`proven`; 124 have no state (partial 47, none recorded 38, not-demonstrable 18, qualified/provisional proven 10, other 11). 0 of 1,862 readiness rows (`unknown`) can be supplied.

## Expected
- A larger closed vocabulary, e.g. `blocked ready proven partial not-demonstrable disputed obsolete not-established unknown`, or a closed `state` plus an optional `qualifier` (`provisional`, `classification-only`) so a qualified outcome is not reported as plain `proven`.
- `docs_coverage` counts per state as today; `unknown` stays distinguishable from absence of a status.

## Acceptance tests
- Each new state builds, appears in `docs_get` and is counted per state by `docs_coverage`.
- A state outside the vocabulary is still refused.
- A qualified `proven` is reported with its qualifier and never counted as unqualified `proven`.
